item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows three transparent pieces Zoya holds close to a printed letter: a convex lens, a concave lens, and a flat glass piece.

Which claim about how the letter appears is correct?

options.A: Through the convex lens the letter looks larger; through the concave lens it looks smaller; through the flat glass it looks about the same size.
options.B: Through the convex lens the letter looks smaller; through the concave lens it looks larger.
options.C: All three pieces make the letter look larger because each is transparent.
options.D: Only the flat glass can change the letter's apparent size; both lenses leave it unchanged.
